source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Clutch and Transmissions, p.7-9

procedures.title: Transmission side cover (Saginaw 3-speed): remove, overhaul and install
steps: Removal: unhook the control rods from the levers (remove the 2-3 cross shaft on Chevrolet).
Put the transmission in the neutral detents before taking off the cover.
Lift the cover off the case carefully and let the oil drain.
Disassembly: remove the outer shifter levers.
Take both shift forks off the shifter shafts, then pull both shifter shafts out of the cover; pry out the shaft O-rings only if they are damaged and need replacing.
Remove the detent cam spring and the pivot C-ring, then both detent cams.
Replace any damaged parts.

Assembly: with the detent spring tang sticking up over the 2nd/3rd shaft opening, put the 1st/reverse detent cam on the pivot pin; with the tang up over the 1st/reverse shaft hole, fit the 2nd/3rd detent cam.
Fit the C-ring on the pivot shaft and hook the spring into the cam notches.
Insert both shifter shafts in the cover without harming the seals; fit both forks, lifting the detent cam so they seat fully.
Fit the outer shifter levers with flat washers, lock washers and bolts.
Installation: put the shifter levers in the center (neutral) detent and lay the gasket on the case.
Set the cover in place with each fork engaged in its mainshaft clutch sliding sleeve.
Install the cover bolts and tighten evenly to specified torque.
Remove the filler plug and fill with the lubricant listed in Section 0 up to the filler hole.
notes: See figure 11 in the manual for the cover parts.

procedures.title: Transmission side cover (Warner 3-speed): remove, overhaul and install
steps: Removal: drain the transmission and unhook the control rod and cross shaft from the side cover levers.
Remove the nine cap screws and take off the cover with forks and gasket.
Disassembly: take the forks off the shift lever assemblies.
Remove the nut and lock washer from each shift lever shaft.
Remove the outer levers and tap the shafts lightly out of the cover.
Remove the two steel balls, poppet spring, interlock pin and interlock sleeve.
Remove the O-rings from the shafts.
Assembly: fit new O-rings to the shafts.
Install the low/reverse shifter shaft and plate in the cover.
